items.title: Spreading the fibre dimension from the generic fibre to a nonempty open of the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism onto an irreducible base whose generic fibre has dimension n, one must produce one nonempty open of the base over which every fibre has dimension exactly n. The proof handles the upper and lower bounds with two closed loci: the locus where the local fibre dimension exceeds n, closed by the openness-of-bounded-dimension lemma and killed over the generic point, hence removable after shrinking; and the locus of dimension at least n, which meets the generic fibre, hence becomes surjective after shrinking. Both shrinking moves are written out with their lemmas. Retained author proof at lines 8419-8432.
